deviation of your procedure titled "Preparation of Health Hazard Assessment Reports", sections 4.1 which requires assessment of the

Based on the above observed issues, your firm provided an assessment report indicating the impurity is mutagenic and a
risk of carcinogenicity cannot be ruled out.
OBSERVATIO~ 2
The accuracy, sensitivity, specificity and reproducibility of test methods have not been established and documented.
Specifically, your firm's analysis of impurities in the same batch at various time points yielded inconsistent results.
OBSERVATION 3
Equipment and utensils are not cleaned and maintained at appropriate intervals to prevent contamination.
Specifically, cleaning records for the blender were not reviewed before the next campaign started.
